About the Team
• You will be part of the Growth team, responsible for driving consumer acquisition, activation, and retention at scale across one of India’s largest and most diverse e-commerce audiences.

• The team owns the full-funnel consumer growth charter — from bringing new users onto the platform, to converting and activating them, to building habits that drive long-term retention.

• Operating in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment, the team combines structured problem-solving with rapid execution and manages a large, complex media budget across performance marketing channels to unlock consumer growth at scale.

About the Role
• We are looking for a Manager – Performance Marketing to join our Growth team and take ownership of consumer acquisition, activation, and retention through performance marketing.

• This is a consumer acquisition mandate (not seller/supply-side) — you will own paid growth across Meta, Google, and emerging platforms, manage a media budget upwards of ₹500 Cr+, and lead a team of performance marketers.

• Beyond deep, hands-on channel expertise, we're looking for someone with a strong growth mindset — who can look around corners, stay ahead of new ad-tech trends and platforms, and translate ambiguous problem statements into innovative, scalable solutions.

What You will Do
Consumer Acquisition & Channel Ownership

• 

Own and scale consumer acquisition, activation, and retention across performance marketing channels (Meta, Google, and emerging/new-age platforms) at scale

• 

Manage a media budget of ₹500 Cr+, driving efficient allocation across channels to maximize incremental consumer growth

• 

Drive high-quality user acquisition with a sharp focus on downstream activation, engagement, and retention

• 

Optimize campaigns for cost-efficient acquisition (CAC) while protecting user quality and long-term value (LTV)

• 

Continuously evaluate and pilot new and emerging ad platforms, formats, and technologies to unlock incremental growth ahead of the curve

Funnel Optimization (Acquisition → Activation → Retention)

• 

Improve consumer funnel metrics such as install/sign-up → first order → repeat purchase

• 

Identify and reduce drop-offs across the acquisition and activation journey

• 

Work closely with product, lifecycle/CRM, and category teams to improve conversion and long-term retention

Team Leadership

• 

Build, lead, and mentor a team of performance marketers, setting a high bar for execution and analytical rigour

• 

Drive goal-setting, performance reviews, and capability development for the team

• 

Partner with senior leadership to shape the consumer growth charter and long-term channel strategy

Experimentation & Growth

• 

Run structured experiments across audiences, creatives, landing pages, and funnel interventions

• 

Identify new growth levers such as regional expansion, category-specific acquisition, and vernacular targeting

• 

Test and scale new channels, formats, and campaign strategies, bringing an innovative, first-principles approach to problem-solving

Performance & Efficiency Management

• 

Monitor and optimize key metrics such as CAC, activation rate, retention, payback period, LTV/CAC, ROAS, CVR, CTR, CPM

• 

Manage budget allocation across channels to maximize incremental consumer growth at scale

• 

Track and mitigate issues like audience saturation, creative fatigue, and declining marginal returns

Insights & Analytics

• 

Analyze consumer cohorts by geography, category, and lifecycle stage

• 

Derive insights on consumer behaviour to improve targeting, messaging, and channel-mix decisions

• 

Build and refine frameworks for incrementality and attribution for consumer acquisition

Cross-functional Collaboration

• 

Partner with product, analytics, design, and category teams to align growth efforts

• 

Influence onboarding experience, landing pages, and communication strategy based on performance insights

What Will You Need
• 

6+ years of experience in performance marketing, with a strong track record in consumer internet, e-commerce, or large fintech companies in growth roles

• 

Proven experience managing large-scale media budgets (₹100 Cr+) across Meta Ads & Google Ads, with deep, hands-on channel expertise

• 

Team management experience — having built, led, or mentored a team of performance marketers

• 

Strong awareness of emerging trends and platforms in performance marketing/ad-tech, beyond core Meta & Google expertise, with the ability to evaluate and adopt new opportunities early

• 

A strong growth mindset — able to go beyond subject-matter expertise to independently identify problem statements and drive innovative, structured solutions

• 

Solid understanding of incrementality frameworks and key growth/performance metrics such as CPM, CTR, hook rate, CAC, LTV, reach, frequency, and attribution models

• 

Hands-on experience with consumer acquisition, activation, and retention funnels at scale (not seller/supply-side acquisition)

• 

Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets; working knowledge of SQL or analytics tools is a plus

• 

Strong analytical thinking with a structured, problem-first approach and a bias for action

• 

Ability to operate with high ownership in a fast-paced environment

• 

Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and work cross-functionally

About the Team
We are looking for an experienced Executive Business Partner to support our GM, India and our Head of Enterprise Sales, based in Mumbai. This person will help both leaders operate with clarity, focus, and momentum across India-specific priorities, India regional work, and HQ partnership.
You will manage highly dynamic calendars, complex travel, internal and external communications, and operating rhythms that keep leaders and teams aligned across markets and time zones. You will also serve as a key point of contact for executives visiting India from HQ, helping coordinate local context, schedules, logistics, and meetings.
This is a high-trust role that requires excellent judgment, discretion, cross-cultural fluency, and the ability to move quickly without losing precision. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguous, high-growth environments; enjoys creating order and systems; and is energized by supporting leaders who operate across geographies, functions, and stakeholder groups. Fluency in Hindi and English is required.
Our Executive Business Partners serve as trusted advisors and collaborators to OpenAI's executives and leaders, focused on strong communication and operational excellence across teams. With a focus on elevating the impact and efficiency of leadership, we anticipate needs, streamline processes, and provide comprehensive support to ensure our executives can focus on high-impact initiatives. We play a pivotal role in driving success and achieving key milestones by cultivating strong relationships and leveraging our deep understanding of business objectives. With a commitment to excellence and a proactive approach, we are dedicated to empowering our executives and contributing to the overall growth and success of the company.
Our leadership team reflects OpenAI’s culture and core values and is a mission-driven, kind, and thoughtful group. We take pride in creating a work environment that fosters collaboration, open communication, and authenticity, making OpenAI an excellent place to work for highly accomplished professionals.
About the Role
The Executive Business Partner will be a proactive and adaptable partner to executives, managing complex scheduling, coordinating projects, and optimizing workflows. This role requires independence, task-level ownership, and a deep understanding of OpenAI’s mission to foster AGI that benefits humanity. The ideal candidate is comfortable with ambiguity, rapidly-evolving business priorities, and can drive best practices to help scale exec and team operations.
This role is based in Mumbai, India. We follow a hybrid work model of three days in the office each week.
In this role, you will:
• 
Build strong connections within the immediate team and across other departments, becoming a trusted partner to leaders. This includes an understanding of team dynamics, priorities, and stakeholders, facilitating seamless coordination on high-stakes projects.
• 
Excel in sharing information clearly and efficiently, adapting communication styles for a broad range of audiences.
• 
Balance the calendars and priorities of multiple leaders, demonstrating prioritization skills and agility in adapting to shifts in priorities, while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.
• 
Operate with discretion and independence, proactively optimizing processes and flagging risks, while ensuring sensitive information is handled with care.
You might thrive in this role if you have:
• 
5+ years experience in a cross-functional executive assistant role or similar support function.
• 
Successfully supported multiple leaders in the past.
• 
Worked in a hard tech startup or similar environment.
• 
Experience working across APAC markets and collaborating with U.S.-based HQ teams.
• 
High cross-cultural EQ and ability to tailor communication styles for diverse stakeholders.
• 
Strong operational rigor — able to run cadences, track priorities, and maintain alignment across time zones.
• 
Comfortable supporting complex, rapid travel across international regions.
• 
Strong communication - being able to tailor a message appropriate to a specific audience (writing an email to a Senator vs. a Customer vs. an Exec).
• 
Discretion - this role will have exposure to sensitive knowledge so must be rock solid on confidentiality.
• 
Humility/diplomacy - this role has the potential to accrue power in a unique ways, but we want this person to be decisive and make noncontroversial decisions.
• 
Very fluent in Google Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Gmail, etc. and other modern productivity software, and are excited to learn and use new tools.
• 
Genuine interest in the technology we’re building and the transformative potential of AI.

About OpenAI
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
